notes.title: Waves Reforged: Playtest v1.2.0
notes.notes: [p][b]New Content[/b][/p][p]- [b]Game difficulty[/b] settings: Danger Levels![/p][p]- 2 [b]new elite enemies[/b] added. Each elite encounter is now randomly selected from the elite pool.[/p][p]- Brand [b]new enemy type[/b] introduced[/p][p]- Added [b]new wave patterns[/b] with further rebalancing.[/p][p]- [b]New spell[/b]: Frost Shiv[/p][p]- Pots can now drop [b]different orb types[/b]:[/p][p]	- [b]Armor Orb[/b] (grey): Restores armor.[/p][p]	- [b]Bloodcup Orb[/b] (red): Refills your Bloodcup.[/p][p]	- [b]Healing Orb[/b] (geen): Heals +1 HP[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][p]- Healing orbs are now green[/p][p]- Reduced cooldown on Wotu Kak’s special ability[/p][p]- Toxicum Staff now attacks faster against frosted or poisoned enemies[/p][p]- Several spell descriptions rewritten for clarity[/p][p]- Echo Shank has been nerfed[/p][p]- Elites are not affected by Frost or Parasite[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quality of life[/b][/p][p]- Added a game setting to adjust chromatic aberration[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]- Fixed a rare crash that could occur if the player died on the same frame they threw a melee attack.[/p][p]- Marata's max HP was incorrectly adjusted by token Blood For Power[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where Crown Breaker was not benefiting from the Twinfire token[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where Shull was not benefiting from the Twinfire token[/p][p]- Alpha and Omega token now displays the correct damage in the spell info pane[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bugfixes v1.1.1 + new player
notes.notes:
Some small bugfixes + 1 new playable character

[list]
[*] There was a rare chance the game would crash when the player dies
[*] Burn was not affected by token The Expanding Sin
[*] Sin of Second Thoughts did not take Spell Buff cards into account
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.4 Gamepad support
notes.notes: Version v1.0.4 has now full gamepad support.

notes.title: Bugfixes v1.0.3
notes.notes: The last bugfix said restarting the game from the lobby would let you keep your tokens… but turns out, that wasn’t actually fixed. It is now. Goodbye exploiting tokens!

notes.title: Bugfixes v1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed a crash caused by Crown Breaker under certain circumstances.

Fixed an issue where restarting the game from the lobby allowed players to keep their tokens.

Fixed a crash caused by pressing the ESC key in the lobby.

Fixed an issue where the pause menu could be opened during the first token round, showing option buttons without actually pausing the game.

notes.title: The Playtest Is Live!
notes.notes: [p]The playtest for Bloody Shrine is now open—thank you so much for jumping in! I’m really looking forward to hearing your thoughts.[/p][p]For direct feedback, bug reports, and general discussion, I highly recommend joining the Discord server. It’s the best place to chat with me and others about your experience.[/p][p][b]A few things to keep in mind during this playtest:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]No meta progression (yet):[/b] This is intentional. I want you to have access to most of what the game currently offers so you can freely experiment. Try out different weapons and spells—see which ones you love, and which ones might need some tuning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Waves and difficulty:[/b] After [b]Wave 11[/b], enemy types will repeat but with increasing HP and damage. You're [i]not[/i] expected to survive much longer past that point. The final game will include more enemy variety, elite units, and boss fights—some of which will roll out in future playtest updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Music is still in the works:[/b] There’s no in-game music just yet. I’m still on the hunt for the perfect banger track to match the vibe.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing—your feedback will help shape where the game goes next![/p]
